introduction.en: I am an Associate Professor at the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. My research focuses on dynamic compilation and system security, including cross-instruction-set virtualization and system defense.
introduction.zh: 我现任中国科学院计算技术研究所副研究员。我的研究方向为动态编译与系统安全，包括跨指令集虚拟化、系统防御等。
